ms.promise:
Define the requirements for the extended functionality of chain indexer to extract and process voting history data from the Cardano blockchain. This will likely be working with Sanchonet.
This will lay the foundation to create a dashboard to display dRep data. So that users can navigate the modified dashboard to explore dReps, gaining an initial understanding of their presence within the Cardano ecosystem.
﻿﻿Note: We are eager to work with sanchonet, but the delivery of this proposal will depend on how feasible it is to build a custom chain indexer that interacts with sanchonet which is still in development.
In the proposal we suggested the first milestone to be "Fork dashboard of web3.crystal.vote to display dReps", but since our product has been extended and enhanced. We will be extending the functionality of https://www.clarity.vote/, but before we do this we need to provide a technical specification of how it will be accomplished.
ms.criteria:
Develop a technical specification document outlining the implementation details and integration process.
This custom chain indexer is to extract and process voting history data from dReps.
We will also develop data structures to efficiently store and query delegation metrics associated with dReps.﻿﻿﻿
We understand how to create backend to fetch and display dReps data.

ms.report:
A. Output: Design the user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) of the dRep dashboard, ensuring intuitive navigation and visual clarity.
Acceptance criteria: Creation of wireframes which will be developed into the user interface and user experience of the dRep explorer and dashboard.
Evidence: This demo illustrates how easily dReps can create and run sentiment polls to engage their communities and how community members can explore dReps. The interface is designed for intuitive navigation, with clearly defined steps for creating polls and configuring governance parameters. Visual clarity and simplicity are core to the experience, ensuring dReps can make decisions confidently and efficiently.
Demo Video dRep Community Polling: https://youtu.be/RStIu-xZuSc?si=gsjK-BXgf-HMXdAK
Demo Video dRep Explorer: https://youtu.be/3AZkLQAL5vw
Demo Access: https://www.clarity.vote/cardano-governance

Acceptance criteria: A document explaining how we store and organize data.
Evidence: Document explaining data collection and storage: https://docsend.com/view/pk5krzke2yjwvdwm
C. Output: Conduct user research and gather feedback to understand the desired user experience and requirements for the dRep dashboard.
Acceptance criteria: No acceptance criteria were stated in the milestone.
Evidence: No evidence of completion is stated in the milestone for this output. But we have spoken with dReps and community members, which evidence will be submitted as part of the final milestone.
